title: Stood firm in a storm
text: We had two nights with strong wind on Kvaløya and the tent did not move. The snow flaps really work. Pitching took about ten minutes with gloves on.

title: Pole snapped on the second trip
text: One pole section broke in what felt like normal wind. Customer service was slow to answer. Please call me on +47 400 00 555 because email does not work for me.

title: Solid vintertelt
text: Veldig stabilt i vind og lett å sette opp. Litt tungt å bære alene, men det er verdt det. Trekker en stjerne for kondens når ventilene er lukket.

title: Perfekt für vier
text: Wir waren zu viert eine Woche in Nordnorwegen. Viel Platz, große Apsis für das Gepäck. Der Aufbau ist auch bei Wind einfach.

title: Great summer tent
text: Light and quick to pitch. The two doors are useful. It is a summer tent, so do not expect it to handle snow.

title: Grei, men trang
text: Teltet er lett og fint, men to voksne med store sekker får det trangt. Glidelåsen hekter seg av og til.

title: Room for the whole family
text: Two adults and one child with space to spare. Stayed dry in a full night of rain.

title: Under one kilo, really
text: I weighed it at 975 grams. It needs a trekking pole and some practice to pitch tight. Perfect for fast solo trips.

title: Zu viel Kondenswasser
text: Bei feuchtem Wetter war innen alles nass. Für den Preis hätte ich mehr erwartet. Das Gewicht ist allerdings top.

title: Warm at minus eight
text: I am a cold sleeper and I was warm at minus eight with a good mat. The hood closes well.

title: Sehr warm, aber groß im Rucksack
text: Hält, was er verspricht. Das Packmaß ist größer als erwartet, im 55-Liter-Rucksack wird es eng.

title: Feathers everywhere
text: Down came out of the seams from the first night. I want my money back. This is the worst bag I have owned and I am angry about it.

title: Fin høstpose
text: Varm nok ned mot null. Veier lite og pakker lite. Glidelåsen kunne vært kraftigere.

title: Expedition quality
text: Used it at minus twenty-two on Finnmarksvidda. Slept through the night. Expensive, but worth it.

title: Fine for huts
text: Good for summer and cabin trips. It is heavy and bulky compared with down. You get what you pay for.

title: Bra til prisen
text: Kjøpte to til barna. Fungerer fint på hytta og om sommeren. Tåler vask i maskin.

title: Warm on snow
text: No cold from below on snow. A bit noisy when you turn. The pump sack works well.

title: Slow leak after a month
text: It loses air during the night. I could not find the hole. I expected better for this price.

title: Leicht und bequem
text: Für den Sommer völlig ausreichend. Kleines Packmaß. Im Herbst wird es von unten kalt.

title: Kan ikke punktere
text: Enkelt og trygt. Bruker det under luftmadrassen om vinteren. Billig forsikring.

title: Carries twenty kilos well
text: The hip belt takes the weight. I followed the fitting guide and it made a big difference. No sore shoulders after five days.

title: God sekk, dårlig regntrekk
text: Sekken sitter godt, men regntrekket blåste av i vinden. Lommene på hoftebeltet er for små for telefonen min.

title: Guter Trekkingrucksack
text: Sitzt nach dem Einstellen sehr gut. Die Rückenlänge M passt mir bei 47 cm. Ein Stern Abzug für das Gewicht.

title: Big and stable
text: A week of food and a winter tent fit inside. Stable even when full.

title: Good everyday pack
text: I use it for work and for short hikes. The rain cover is a nice extra.

title: Perfekt dagstursekk
text: Passe stor, lett og med regntrekk. Har blitt favorittsekken.

title: Strap came loose
text: The shoulder strap seam opened after three weeks. I sent photos from nina.f@example.com but have no answer yet.

title: Made for ski touring
text: Skis go on fast, and the shovel pocket is easy to reach. Fits a helmet inside.

title: Durchdachter Tourenrucksack
text: Skibefestigung funktioniert gut, auch mit Handschuhen. Für Mehrtagestouren etwas klein.

title: Stiff and warm
text: Used with the Bre 12 Semi crampons on Folgefonna. The heel welt holds the crampon firmly. No blisters after a short break-in.

title: Smal i tåboksen
text: Gode støvler, men smale foran. Jeg måtte gå opp en halv størrelse. Sålen er veldig stiv, som den skal være.

title: Sole came off
text: The sole started to separate after four trips. This is dangerous on a glacier. I think this should be recalled.

title: Warme Füße bei minus 15
text: Mit den Is 14 Auto Steigeisen eine perfekte Kombination. Schwer, aber sehr warm und stabil.

title: Serious winter boot
text: Warm and precise. It takes all crampon types. Heavy for long approaches.

title: Good trekking boot
text: Comfortable from day one. Remember that it only takes strap-on crampons.

title: Feil stegjern anbefalt
text: Jeg fikk anbefalt Bre 12 Semi til denne støvelen i chatten, men den passer ikke. Støvelen har ikke hælkant. Måtte sende stegjernene tilbake.

title: Light summer shoe
text: Good grip on dry rock. Not waterproof, as the page says.

title: Tørre føtter
text: Gikk en hel dag i regn og myr uten å bli våt. Sitter godt rundt ankelen.

title: Okay, aber warm
text: Wasserdicht, ja. Im Sommer aber sehr warm am Fuß. Für den Herbst gut.

title: Easy to fit
text: Fitted to my Tind B2 boots in five minutes using the manual. Solid on hard ice.

title: Gode allround stegjern
text: Sitter stødig på støvler med hælkant. Antisnøplatene fungerer bra i våt snø.

title: Bites into steep ice
text: Fourteen points and a firm click on the heel lever. Only for B3 boots, so check before you buy.

title: Good for glacier walks
text: Straps fit my Rygg B1 boots well. Takes a few minutes longer to put on than a clip binding.

title: Riemen zu lang
text: Funktioniert, aber die Riemen sind sehr lang und müssen gekürzt werden. Anleitung beachten.

title: Dry in a full day of rain
text: Eight hours of rain on Besseggen and I stayed dry. The hood fits over a helmet.

title: Zuverlässige Regenjacke
text: Hält dicht und ist atmungsaktiv genug. Der Reißverschluss ist etwas steif.

title: Lekker i skuldrene
text: Etter to måneder trekker den vann i skuldrene under sekken. Skuffet over holdbarheten.

title: Like wearing a sleeping bag
text: Very warm for its weight. I use it for every break in winter.

title: Varm og lett
text: Perfekt i pauser. Tåler ikke regn, så ha skalljakke med.

title: Angenehme Wolle
text: Kratzt nicht und wärmt auch feucht. Riecht nach drei Tagen noch nicht.

title: Tiny and useful
text: Weighs nothing and blocks the wind on ridges. Not for rain.

title: Small and powerful
text: Boils a litre in under four minutes. Fits inside my mug with a small gas canister.

title: Flame flared up, burned my tent
text: I lit it in the vestibule and the flame shot up and melted a hole in the flysheet. This product is unsafe. Someone could get badly hurt.

title: Fungerer, men vindutsatt
text: Koker fort i stille vær. I vind tar det mye lengre tid uten vindskjerm.

title: Schnell und sparsam
text: Ein Liter Wasser in zweieinhalb Minuten. Der Windschutz ist eingebaut. Sehr zufrieden.

title: Fast system
text: Very fast and stable. A bit tall to pack. The igniter failed once in the cold.

title: Virker i sprengkulde
text: Brukt på minus 25 med renset bensin. Tenner hver gang når man forvarmer riktig.

title: Turns night into day
text: The beam is huge. Keeping the battery inside my jacket gave me the full burn time at minus fifteen.

title: Good value
text: Bright enough for skiing home in the dark. Charging takes about three hours.

title: Einfach und günstig
text: Für das Lager reicht sie. Für den Abstieg im Dunkeln zu schwach.
